testcase.name: only admins trigger a server access check
access is granted only for HTTP 200 with granted === true
service failures are reported as unavailable, never as granted
tab segments are validated and default to the overview
research paths match the /admin/research/:componentId/:tab? routes
all four research components are registered; only the learner profile has a dedicated page
the five existing tabs are preserved and the IMLR demo is a sixth tab
every exported scenario is labelled synthetic and maps to a complete view
questions render the real form: one correct option holding the largest count, chosen answer marked
transfer results come from the exported outcomes, not recomputed
pre-probe and teaching are classified separately; teaching is always guided
missing or incomplete assistance records are shown as unknown with the reason
breaks and help after answering are explained without changing independence
snapshot inputs and transfer outcomes are separated
default language is Sinhala
values captured at module level follow the switch (no reload)
pick() chooses the current language and falls back to the other
subscribers are told about a change, and only once per real change
parentText: Sinhala and English have the same keys and every value is filled in
teacherText: Sinhala and English have the same keys and every value is filled in
publicText: Sinhala and English have the same keys and every value is filled in
key wording switches language
each role gets exactly the requested links (English)
the same links switch to Sinhala
admins and signed-out sessions keep the public links; there is no student role
links point at existing routes
active link highlighting
no interaction: nothing is invented
time from item display to first interaction
rapid repeated taps are recorded as a burst with timestamps and count
two taps alone are not a burst (minimum is a recording parameter)
an open burst is included in the snapshot without changing state
idle intervals between interactions and at the end
page visibility and focus changes with hidden duration
invalid taps outside interactive targets
event lists are capped and marked truncated
records contain no positions, key values or interpretations
DOM wiring: listeners record events and detach cleanly
unseen questions are never submitted
presented but unanswered questions are sent as skipped with no time or answer
response time is the measured time to the first answer, never a default
time accumulates across visits until the first answer
an answer for a question that is not on screen does not set a time
answered items without a measured time omit responseTimeSeconds
only collected evidence fields are passed through
guided support is not counted as independent performance
helped or unconfirmed items are listed separately, never as independent
older records without evidence flags fall back to the original wording
chart points run oldest to newest and keep missing scores as gaps, not zeros
averages and dates are formatted for parents
directions get neutral arrows only (no better/worse meaning)
nearest answer step stays on the 0–3 SNAP-IV scale
